pr_body:
This migration fixes corrupted privilege descriptors in the wild resulting
from the fallout of the ZONECONFIG/USAGE bug and the ALTER DATABASE CONVERT TO
SCHEMA bug. Additionally, all privilege descriptors will be updated to explicitly
have Owners. Privilege descriptors created before 20.2 do not have their owner field
set and instead owners are implicitly inferred.

Finally all privilege descriptors will be bumped up to Version21_2 after the migration
so we can strictly validate privileges.

Release note (bugfix): This migration will be run when users upgrade to
21.2 (Specifically 21.2.14).
This migration fixes any privilege descriptors that are corrupted from the
fallout of the ZONECONFIG/USAGE bug on tables and databases after upgrading
from 20.1 -> 20.2 (#65010) and those that are corrupted after converting a
database to a schema (#65697).

Fixes #65012
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/66495)

> Somewhat related and I might be wrong, but the backup case could perhaps be handled by adding a new upgrade step to the`RunPostDeserializationChanges` method of `catalog.DescriptorBuilder`, in which case it'd be appropriate to include in this PR.

I added a call to `MaybeFixPrivileges` in `RunPostDeserializationChanges` for all objects which guarantees that restores will catch it too. My question here is when can we remove this? We'll have to keep it here until we have an API that allows us to sync migrations and restores.

> I added a call to MaybeFixPrivileges in RunPostDeserializationChanges for all objects which guarantees that restores will catch it too. My question here is when can we remove this? We'll have to keep it here until we have an API that allows us to sync migrations and restores.

Sadly, not in a long while. Certainly not while we support backups from affected versions, which would be any version up until now, basically. My understanding is that this is a consequence of migrations simply not being a thing until quite recently.

Really appreciate the tight review cycles, thank you!

bors r=ajwerner

issue_context.title: sql: create long running migration to fix privilege descriptors for tables/db created on 20.1 or before
issue_context.body:
Would like a more permanent solution to fixing USAGE on tables/db descs created in 20.1.

https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/pull/65010 

Example:
https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/master/pkg/migration/migrations/foreign_key_representation_upgrade.go

Must also make sure restore is aware of this case:
https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/issues/58611

Epic CRDB-2476

Hi @RichardJCai, please add a C-ategory label to your issue. Check out the [label system docs](https://go.crdb.dev/p/issue-labels).

While you're here, please consider adding an A- label to help keep our repository tidy. 

<sub>:owl: Hoot! I am a [Blathers](https://github.com/apps/blathers-crl), a bot for [CockroachDB](https://github.com/cockroachdb). My owner is [otan](https://github.com/otan).</sub>

Another long running migration has to be done for solving corrupted PrivilegeDescriptors on schemas in the wild.

However in addition to that, I'm wondering if people think it'll be worth it to upgrade PrivilegeDescriptors that do not have Owners - the Owner field is set as "". I don't think it's necessary but may be nice to guarantee that our PrivilegeDescriptors are consistent in the future?

We could also upgrade of our PrivilegeDescriptors to a new version ensuring that they're consistent (valid Privileges and have Owners) for 21.2. 

We have a Version field on our PrivilegeDescriptors that is currently never updated and only used to verify if a PrivilegeDescriptor can have an empty owner field. 
https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach/blob/master/pkg/sql/catalog/descpb/privilege.go#L36

We can upgrade the version field for all PrivilegeDescriptors and use the version field to determine if a descriptor needs a fix/migration or not.

cc @ajwerner
